TMC Factional Dispute: Rebel Group Stakes Claim with Election Commission

A faction of the Trinamool Congress, led by Ritabrata Banerjee, has met with the Election Commission of India. The group is seeking control over the party's name and election symbol amidst an ongoing internal dispute. This development follows challenges from TMC chief Mamata Banerjee, who has accused rebels of being instigated by the BJP and has taken over as the Bengal unit chief.
